channel.title: IT services · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on IT services in Indian markets. Today: mixed (−0.7).

item.title: [−1] Sensex opens 120 points higher at 74,849 but slips to about 74,378 by midday on oil worries
item.description:
Nifty opened at 23,150.85 after gaining about 2.8% last week. State-run banks led early while private banks and IT lagged. Foreign investors turned buyers on Friday after 15 sessions of selling. Pausing after last week's rally.

IT services: mild headwind (−1) — IT gives back gains

Why it matters: A pause after a strong week as crude near $108 and Hormuz tensions cap gains; a turn in foreign flows would support heavyweights if it lasts.

Market gauges: Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days

item.title: [−1] Rupee opens firmer near 94.86–94.90 per dollar, extending its winning streak
item.description:
The rupee settled at 94.89 on Friday and touched 94.80 in early trade Monday with RBI support expected. One report puts it at a seventh straight gain. Ongoing recovery.

IT services: mild headwind (−1) — Smaller currency gain

Why it matters: A steadier rupee eases imported inflation and the rupee cost of crude, helping fuel retailers and airlines.

Market gauges: Rupee +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days

item.title: [+1] US says it is 'very close' to finalising a trade deal with India; talks in Mumbai on 20 October
item.description:
The US Secretary of State said the deal was 'taken into account' when waiving Russia-oil sanctions. India says the first phase is in legal drafting. Escalating progress.

IT services: mild tailwind (+1) — Better US trade ties

Why it matters: A signed deal would cut US tariffs on Indian goods and reduce the risk of renewed Russia-oil penalties, lifting exporters and investor sentiment.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Foreign investor flows +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months
